status: proposed design, not implemented or submitted for training
objective: Determine whether actual two-part unwrapping gives complementary features for missed tissue, extra tissue, and anterior/posterior swaps.

representation.operation: Cut along the longitudinal plane and open both sides into surface-coordinate charts with retained depth. Do not substitute centreline straightening.
representation.coordinate_policy: Coordinates derive from the image affine and a training-only coarse predictor, never validation annotation. Scale coordinates by fixed training-derived or physical scales; do not use the A/P label boundary.
representation.halves: Keep opposite sides identifiable and process with shared encoder weights. Preserve small additional chart pieces; do not silently discard them to enforce exactly two connected charts.
representation.support: Start with the predicted region plus 8 mm context, verify coverage, and audit missed tissue. All available context remains an input; predicted foreground is not an intensity mask.
representation.sampling: Choose chart resolution using original-space sampling footprints. Preserve source-resolution detail where possible, retain depth samples, and quantify any loss. Display UV units are not assumed to be millimetres.
representation.seams: Prevent convolution across unrelated packed charts; retain overlap and correspondence at genuine seams. Mark padding and invalid sampling explicitly.

encoder.fine_path: A small residual CNN that retains full chart and depth resolution. Begin with within-layer kernels, followed by kernels spanning neighbouring depth layers.
encoder.context_path: A small parallel path with reduced surface resolution, retained depth resolution, and a whole-half pooled summary. Combine its context with the fine features.

purpose.missed_and_extra_tissue: Retain weak intensity transitions, thin structures, neighbouring depth evidence, and surrounding background.
purpose.AP_swaps: Combine local appearance with longitudinal position and the wider organisation of each half.

encoder.sizing: Finalize channels and chart dimensions after coverage and memory profiling; no fixed 64-cube compression requirement.

fusion.site: One native decoder stage near the segmentation output.
fusion.mapping: For each native feature-grid centre, sample corresponding fine/context features from the correct chart and depth. Handle scale, voxel centres, and validity explicitly.
fusion.operation: Normalize branch features, concatenate with native decoder features and validity, then use a learned channel projection and local convolution block.
fusion.interpretation: The network may learn to use or ignore unfolded evidence. This is not an oracle selector of hard voxels and does not require channel-wise feature agreement.

learning.loss: Original Dice plus original depth-balanced cross-entropy on native voxels, with the existing per-regime coefficient and schedule.
learning.coverage: All supported voxels are processed densely initially; do not select only uncertain or high-depth points.
learning.guides: Use cross-fitted training predictions. For 5% data, guide models use only that subset; validation guides use only training data.
learning.geometry_in_training: Freeze the precomputed guide geometry for this first architecture experiment. Gradients train feature encoders and fusion through sampling, not the guide construction.
learning.native_loss_measure: Each native voxel contributes once to the objective; chart area distortion and duplicate seam samples do not multiply supervision.

acceptance_checks_before_training: Show actual two-part MRI unwrapping alongside its native correspondences on case 164 and additional cases.
Report sampling coverage for all native tissue, false negatives, false positives, and each depth band; record uncovered voxels rather than dropping them from evaluation.
Measure collisions, local distortion, seam errors, interpolation, and depth preservation; visual separation alone is insufficient.
Check feature return using known coordinate-valued fields and verify gradient flow through both halves and fusion.
Verify all input channels and guide provenance exclude validation labels.
Verify controlled changes to one chart affect the intended native locations and do not mix opposite halves.

comparison: Native SwinUNETR with original depth loss
Same added encoder and fusion receiving ordinary plane-aligned MRI parts
Same encoder and fusion receiving genuinely unwrapped parts
evaluation.control_matching: Match parameters, auxiliary input channels, sample count, context coverage, training schedule, and guide information as closely as geometry permits; report compute and residual differences.
regimes: Full MSD training data, fold 0 seed 0
evaluation.schedule: Existing maximum 75 epochs and early-stopping policy.
metrics: Missed and extra voxel counts separately
Per-depth counts and rates with denominators
evaluation.error_accounting: Report how many baseline errors are corrected and how many previously correct voxels become wrong, by error type and depth. Evaluate the complete native output.
evaluation.branch_diagnostics: Monitor gradient flow, feature scale, and fusion use. Suppressed or shuffled branch features at validation are sensitivity checks with distribution-shift caveats, not substitutes for trained controls.
evaluation.interpretation: Improvement is unproven. One reused validation fold supports an exploratory comparison, not a generalization claim.

later_only_if_needed.adaptive_refinement: If dense high-resolution processing is too costly, test extra fine sampling using a mixture of uncertainty, spatial/depth coverage, and training-only observed errors. Retain uniform coverage to include confidently wrong voxels. This is a separate ablation.
later_only_if_needed.branch_supervision: If fusion ignores a useful branch, investigate training dynamics before adding an auxiliary objective; do not silently add constraints.

references.transfer_limit: These papers motivate architecture principles; neither validates two-part hippocampal unwrapping.
